about: A test of the flight look on one page of the Wang Bi lesson; round 7 of wangbi-flight-test (new bed and beacon, no chirps) is the starting point. The user, 2026-09-27: 'Love the new direction. Can we maybe do a couple more?' This version adds four sounds rebuilt after the Nostromo boot sequence's inventory (docs/research/nostromo-boot-inventory.json), each at its moment: a sweep as the view starts, a relay bank's chatter while the lines plot, a warble as the camera reaches L5, a wind-down as the answer stops typing. No music.
